title: Read BOM-prefixed configuration in shared consumers
prompt: Our config word counter and item batcher need to accept BOM-prefixed text. Please add keyword-only strip_bom=False to the shared parse_config function. When enabled, ignore exactly one U+FEFF at the absolute start, keeping every other character literal and retaining original line numbers. Default parsing and format_config round trips must stay unchanged. The existing config_word_counts and config_batches consumers already request this option and should follow their docstrings.
parts: Add opt-in leading-BOM parsing for both consumers while preserving literal content and default parsing.
